Bundled as internal/local product-reference art pending release-license review. deviceSource numbers added from the user model assignments collected in the feedback database (2026-09-01, 104 reports carrying an assignment). Only deviceSource values of 1000000 or more with at least two independent reports were accepted; deviceType was never used, and the self-contradictory low band (15/101/102/104) was rejected. See DEVICE_SOURCE_CODES in scripts/assets/build-device-catalog.py for the per-code adjudication.
